patch_description:
Replace independent per-destination shortest paths with a greedy directed multicast-tree construction. The algorithm repeatedly attaches the nearest unserved destination to the already reachable broadcast tree using multi-source Dijkstra. Once an edge is in the tree, subsequent destinations can reuse its source-to-node prefix rather than paying for separate full routes from the source.

This preserves a complete path for every destination and partition, while reducing redundant transfers on shared cloud-network segments. Edge costs missing from the pricing grid are treated as unavailable rather than allowing invalid cost comparisons.
